ja.title: 抗原量とE:T比からTCEの薬効を予測できるか
ja.summary: 5T4×CD3の公開薬効図を数値化し、抗原量とE:T比を用いる小さなHillモデルを未使用株・条件で検証。平均的な改善と予測が外れる条件を比較する。
ja.seo_title: 5T4 TCEの抗原量・E:T比と未使用株での薬効予測
ja.seo_description: 14細胞株の5T4×CD3公開図を再解析。抗原量に応じたEC50・最大効果モデルを株単位で検証し、E:T比の別条件予測、読取誤差、外挿の限界を示す。

en.title: Can antigen density and effector ratio predict TCE cytotoxicity?
en.summary: Digitized 5T4×CD3 responses test whether antigen abundance or E:T ratio predicts withheld lines or conditions, with explicit limits on clinical extrapolation.
en.seo_title: TCE response: antigen abundance and held-out predictions
en.seo_description: Digitized 5T4×CD3 responses test whether antigen abundance or E:T ratio predicts withheld lines or conditions, within the limits of one study's figures.

english.title: Can antigen density and effector ratio predict TCE cytotoxicity?
english.summary: Grouped validation of small Hill models against digitized 5T4×CD3 observed means. Cell-line and E:T held-out tests are separated; no clinical-dose or QSP superiority claim is made.
